title: Ranked matchmaking / dedicated servers
body: Done across 1.28-1.32: official dedicated server (Oracle, bot fill), ranked stats + leaderboard on the master server, and now skill matchmaking — players get a skill rating (avg XP/match after 3 matches), /list carries each server's average, Quick Play prefers the server at your level. Gate: net case 'ranked' (matchmaking_test).

title: Skill-based matchmaking for Quick Play
body: Skill = average XP per match (3+ online matches). Master /list adds per-server average skill, /profile adds yours; Quick Play adds a capped relative skill-gap penalty to its ping score; server list marks 'your level'; leaderboard shows your skill.
